column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran ketujuh belas ekor panjang.
# Bagian 3 dari empat berkas yang ditulis sekaligus (48-51). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").
# Salah ketik permainan yang disalin apa adanya: "<color=#f26c1c>4%</color of Max HP"
# (tag tutup rusak, kurang tanda ">").
# --- serangan ---
=Targets the furthest and closest enemy units, dealing Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack.
column2: Menyasar unit musuh terjauh dan terdekat, memberikan Physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> Attack.

column1: =Deals Physical damage to the furthest and closest enemy units.
column2: Memberikan Physical damage ke unit musuh terjauh dan terdekat.

column1: =Selects the farthest enemy target and deals <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack to them.
column2: Memilih target musuh terjauh dan memberikan <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> Attack kepada mereka.

column1: =Targets the closest enemy unit, dealing AoE Physical damage to all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of the target, and generates a <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> tile.
column2: Menyasar unit musuh terdekat, memberikan AoE Physical damage ke semua unit musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color> dari target, lalu menghasilkan tile <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Deals <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color> to the enemy target and generates a <color=#f26c1c>3x3 area</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> tiles.
column2: Memberikan <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color> ke target musuh lalu menghasilkan <color=#f26c1c>area 3x3</color> berisi tile <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Selects 1 direction and deals AoE physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack to all enemies within a <color=#f26c1c>3×5 area in front</color>.
column2: Memilih 1 arah dan memberikan AoE physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> Attack ke semua musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 3×5 di depan</color>.

column1: =Deals AoE physical damage to all enemies within a specified range in front.
column2: Memberikan AoE physical damage ke semua musuh dalam jangkauan tertentu di depan.

column1: =Select 1 enemy target within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> and deal AoE physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> of attack to it and all enemies within <color=#f26c1c>1 tile</color> around it.
column2: Pilih 1 target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 5 tile</color> lalu berikan AoE physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> Attack kepadanya dan semua musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 1 tile</color> di sekitarnya.

column1: =Selects 1 enemy target <color=#f26c1c>within a 3x3 tile area</color> and deals melee Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack to it.
column2: Memilih 1 target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam area 3x3 tile</color> dan memberikan Physical damage melee setara <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> Attack kepadanya.

column1: =Selects 1 enemy target and deals melee Physical damage to it.
column2: Memilih 1 target musuh dan memberikan Physical damage melee kepadanya.

column1: =When attacking an enemy, for every <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of distance to the target, deal <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of additional fixed stability damage.
column2: Saat menyerang musuh, untuk setiap <color=#f26c1c>3 tile</color> jarak ke target, berikan tambahan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> fixed Stability damage.

column1: =When attacking enemy targets, deal additional stability damage based on distance.
column2: Saat menyerang target musuh, berikan tambahan Stability damage berdasarkan jarak.

column1: =After attacking a target whose defense is <color=#f26c1c>0 or lower</color>, deals <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of fixed stability damage.
column2: Setelah menyerang target yang pertahanannya <color=#f26c1c>0 atau kurang</color>, memberikan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> fixed Stability damage.

column1: =Damage dealt is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>; if dealing non-AoE damage, it is reduced by an additional <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Damage yang diberikan berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>; jika damage-nya bukan AoE, berkurang lagi <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: # --- Stability Break ---
=When inflicting Stability Break on an enemy target, cleanses <color=#f26c1c>2 buffs</color> from them and applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Saat menimbulkan Stability Break pada target musuh, membersihkan <color=#f26c1c>2 buff</color> dari mereka lalu menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> selama <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =When inflicting Stability Break on an enemy target, the target takes fixed damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>7%</color> of its max HP.
column2: Saat menimbulkan Stability Break pada target musuh, target itu menerima fixed damage setara <color=#f26c1c>7%</color> Max HP-nya.

column1: =When inflicting Stability Break on an enemy target, all allied units (including this unit) gain <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index and reduce all skill cooldowns by <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Saat menimbulkan Stability Break pada target musuh, semua unit sekutu (termasuk unit ini) mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index dan cooldown semua skill berkurang sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =If this unit has full stability for <color=#f26c1c>3 rounds</color> consecutively, gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Jika Stability unit ini penuh selama <color=#f26c1c>3 ronde</color> berturut-turut, mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

=Cannot be afflicted by Freeze debuffs.
column2: Tidak bisa terkena debuff Freeze.

column2: Freeze damage yang diterima berkurang.Tidak bisa terkena debuff Freeze.

column1: =Immune to movement effects, mobility is fixed at starting mobility.
column2: Kebal terhadap efek pergerakan, Mobility terkunci di nilai awal.

column1: =When in the <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> state, damage taken is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Saat dalam kondisi <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =When not protected by cover, damage taken is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Saat tidak terlindungi Cover, damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =Damage taken by summoned creatures is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Damage yang diterima makhluk summon berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =Damage taken is shared evenly by all allied units.
column2: Damage yang diterima dibagi rata ke semua unit sekutu.

column1: =When this unit's <color=#3487e0>physical summons</color> are on the field, allied units' defense is increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Saat <color=#3487e0>summon physical</color> unit ini ada di medan, Defense unit sekutu meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =If at full HP, healing and damage is increased by <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.
column2: Jika HP penuh, healing dan damage meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.

column1: =Basic attack range is increased by <color=#f26c1c>1 tile</color>, gains <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index after attacking.
column2: Jangkauan basic attack bertambah sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>1 tile</color>, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index setelah menyerang.

column1: =Range is increased by <color=#f26c1c>1 tile</color>, gains <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index after attacking.
column2: Jangkauan bertambah sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>1 tile</color>, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index setelah menyerang.

column1: =The effect range increases to <color=#f26c1c>3x8 tiles in front</color>.
column2: Jangkauan efeknya naik menjadi <color=#f26c1c>3x8 tile di depan</color>.

column1: =Increase <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>'s range by <color=#f26c1c>2 tiles</color>.
column2: Menambah jangkauan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>2 tile</color>.

column1: =Critical damage dealt to enemy units with <color=#f26c1c>0 or lower</color> defense is increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Critical Damage ke unit musuh dengan Defense <color=#f26c1c>0 atau kurang</color> meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =Damage dealt to enemy units with <color=#f26c1c>0 or lower</color> defense is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.
column2: Damage ke unit musuh dengan Defense <color=#f26c1c>0 atau kurang</color> meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

column1: =Effectiveness of applied shields is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> and healing received is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Efektivitas shield yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> dan healing yang diterima meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =When active attacks hit only <color=#f26c1c>1</color> enemy target, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Saat serangan aktif hanya mengenai <color=#f26c1c>1</color> target musuh, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =When attacking enemy targets with <color=#42cce0>Freeze</color> debuffs, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> and it ignores all the target's stability index.
column2: Saat menyerang target musuh yang memiliki debuff <color=#42cce0>Freeze</color>, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> dan mengabaikan seluruh Stability Index target.

column1: =Attack is increased by <color=#f26c1c>3%</color> for <color=#f26c1c>each</color> buff the user has, up to a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.
column2: Attack meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>3%</color> untuk <color=#f26c1c>setiap</color> buff yang dimiliki pengguna, maksimal <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.

column1: =When performing consecutive active attacks on the same enemy target in the same turn, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Saat melakukan serangan aktif berturut-turut pada target musuh yang sama dalam satu giliran, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =If the target is afflicted with any Electric debuffs, this damage is additionally increased by <color=#f26c1c>2.5%</color>.
column2: Jika target terkena debuff Electric, damage ini meningkat tambahan <color=#f26c1c>2.5%</color>.

column1: =Increases defense equal to <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> of max HP.
column2: Menambah Defense setara <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> Max HP.

column1: =Increases attack equal to <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> of max HP.
column2: Menambah serangan setara <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> Max HP.

column1: =At the start of the round, all ally units' Max HP is increased by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of their shield value for <color=#f26c1c>1 round</color>.
column2: Di awal ronde, Max HP semua unit sekutu meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> dari nilai shield mereka selama <color=#f26c1c>1 ronde</color>.

column1: =<color=#3487e0>{0}</color> effect enhanced: Damage taken increase is raised to <color=#f26c1c>17% + 0.08%</color> Array Parameter.
column2: Efek <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> diperkuat: kenaikan damage yang diterima ditingkatkan menjadi <color=#f26c1c>17% + 0.08%</color> Array Parameter.

column1: # --- pemulihan ---
=At the start of the round, recovers HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> of max HP.
column2: Di awal ronde, memulihkan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> Max HP.

column1: =At the end of the round, recovers HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>15%</color> of max HP and cleanses <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuffs.
column2: Di akhir ronde, memulihkan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>15%</color> Max HP dan membersihkan <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuff.

column1: =After being healed, recovers additional HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> of max HP.
column2: Setelah disembuhkan, memulihkan tambahan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> Max HP.

column1: =After taking damage, recovers HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> of max HP.
column2: Setelah menerima damage, memulihkan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> Max HP.

column1: =When receiving healing, for every <color=#f26c1c>1%</color> of initial max HP in overflow healing, attack and max HP are increased by <color=#f26c1c>1%</color>, to a maximum increase of <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Saat menerima healing, untuk setiap <color=#f26c1c>1%</color> Max HP awal dari healing yang berlebih, serangan dan Max HP meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>1%</color>, maksimal naik sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =Restores an allied target's HP and applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Memulihkan HP satu target sekutu lalu menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =At the end of the action, if there are allied units within <color=#f26c1c>4 tiles</color>, restore <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of stability index.
column2: Di akhir aksi, jika ada unit sekutu <color=#f26c1c>dalam 4 tile</color>, memulihkan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Stability Index.

column1: =At the end of the action, if there are allied units within <color=#f26c1c>4 tiles</color>, restore stability index.
column2: Di akhir aksi, jika ada unit sekutu <color=#f26c1c>dalam 4 tile</color>, memulihkan Stability Index.

column1: =Upon death, deals stability damage to enemies within <color=#f26c1c>4 tiles</color> and restores stability for allied targets within <color=#f26c1c>4 tiles</color>.
column2: Saat mati, memberikan Stability damage ke musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 4 tile</color> dan memulihkan Stability target sekutu <color=#f26c1c>dalam 4 tile</color>.

column1: =When killed by an enemy, restore <color=#f26c1c>4 points</color> of stability index to the killer and apply <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to all enemy units.
column2: Saat terbunuh musuh, memulihkan <color=#f26c1c>4 poin</color> Stability Index pada yang membunuhnya dan menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> ke semua unit musuh.

column1: =When killed by an enemy, the killer's stability index is restored and applies <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to all enemy units.
column2: Saat terbunuh musuh, Stability Index yang membunuhnya pulih dan menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> ke semua unit musuh.

column1: =After dying, heals <color=#3487e0>Amni's Leg</color> for <color=#f26c1c>4%</color of Max HP.
column2: Setelah mati, menyembuhkan <color=#3487e0>Amni's Leg</color> sebesar <color=#f26c1c>4%</color of Max HP.

column1: =After dying, heals Amni's Leg.

column2: Jika <color=#3487e0>Blazing Assault</color> ada di akhir aksi, memulihkan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> Attack pada diri sendiri.
